additional_info.subject: RE: 0379382 - ID0379382-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / R1 170001180] There are blackouts on the display CRM:00641000668
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Yunus,
I hope you're doing well.
Based on the photographs shared in the timeline, it appears that the HMI is experiencing a blackout.
We recommend planning a site visit to troubleshoot the issue. During this intervention, it would be advisable to update the DLogic Controller and consider replacing the DP cable.
Additionally, please ensure that there are no loose connections or damages in the USB and DP cables.
As a precaution, kindly bring spare HDMI and USB cables, as well as a replacement screen, in case any of these components need to be swapped out.
For your reference, please find the connection and KA details below to assist with tracing the issue.
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_HMI_Black_Screen/Scrambled_Screen - Dynamics 365
For future reference, your ticket number is
0379382
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.

Hi Abhinav,
In a similar problem before, we replaved the DP cable and updated the Dlogic FW, but it did not work.
When we go to the site for this ticket, we will get a spare DP cable and HMI with us. We will replace the DP cable and update the Dlogic FW, and if the problem persists, we will replace the HMI.
